notes: LT001 and LT002 independently reviewed the blinded candidate and reached the same conclusion. In the first review, reset priority, synchronous write behavior, storage preservation, combinational dual-read behavior, and same-cycle write bypass were checked sequentially from specification understanding through the final RTL. The implementation clears all stored words on a sampled reset edge, suppresses simultaneous write and bypass during reset, updates only the addressed word on a legal write, and independently forwards wdata to each matching read port. In the second review, reset/write collisions, single- and dual-port address matches, nonmatching-port independence, pre-edge bypass visibility, post-write read behavior, and the unspecified pre-reset memory state were independently reconstructed. No concrete legal parameter counterexample or tool failure was present that would justify a parameterization error under guideline v1.1. No substantive process or RTL error was found. Trusted directed simulation and bounded formal verification pass all configured obligations.
